The challenge

+95 PageSpeed score, +67% mobile CVR

V-Femme's Shopify store scored 28 on mobile PageSpeed. A heavy theme, unoptimised media and a stack of conversion-killing apps meant slow loads — and on mobile, slow loads mean lost sales.

What we did

The approach.

01

Performance audit

We profiled the theme, scripts and media to find exactly what was dragging load times down.

02

Theme-level optimisation

Lazy loading, image and font optimisation, critical-CSS and a leaner app stack — speed work done at the source.

03

Core Web Vitals

Tuned LCP, CLS and INP to pass Core Web Vitals across the board.

04

Conversion follow-through

With the store fast, mobile conversion rate climbed immediately — no other changes needed.
